metadata.title: Generate Test Plan Context
metadata.purposeAndUsage: Compile all gathered information (work item, sniffing findings, code changes, Q&A answers) into a structured test-plan-context JSON file and generate an interactive HTML viewer for user review and approval.

output.description: test-plan-context-{workItemId}.json and interactive HTML viewer opened in browser

prerequisites: Sniffing findings in memory (scopeAndImpact, risks, crossServiceConcerns, codeChanges, requirementsVsCode)
Q&A session results in memory (if any)
inject-context.cjs script and context-viewer.html template available
specificActions: Follow the substeps below in sequence
JSON structure must include: workItem, acceptanceCriteria, sniffingFindings, codeChanges, requirementsVsCode, workItemHierarchy, externalContext, openQuestions
codeChanges.files entries MUST be objects with fields: path, changeType, type, description — NOT plain strings
businessLogicChanges strings MUST use 'Label: description' format
requirementsVsCode criterion values MUST be verbatim substrings of acceptance criteria text

Sniffing finding severities: scopeAndImpact default info, risks default warning, crossServiceConcerns default info. Escalate to critical for: cross-account access, IAM/authorization, failure modes, security concerns
Generate HTML viewer using inject-context.cjs script with context-viewer.html template
Open HTML in browser for user review

read: memory.json (all gathered data from previous steps)

tools: write_file - Create JSON and HTML output files
run_command - Execute inject-context.cjs to generate HTML
open_browser - Open HTML viewer in browser
bestPractices: Validate JSON structure before writing — all required top-level keys must be present
Ensure codeChanges.files are objects, never strings
Use verbatim AC text for requirementsVsCode criterion values
Apply severity escalation rules consistently for sniffing findings
Create .qa/test-plan/ directory if it does not exist
Do NOT proceed to next step until user explicitly approves the context

substeps.name: Compile data into test-plan-context JSON
substeps.description: Assemble all gathered data into the structured test-plan-context-{workItemId}.json file
actions: Create .qa/test-plan/ directory if it does not exist

Compile JSON with structure: workItem (id, title, description, state, assignedTo, areaPath, iterationPath), acceptanceCriteria (array of AC items), sniffingFindings (scopeAndImpact, risks, crossServiceConcerns — each with severity), codeChanges (files as objects with path/changeType/type/description, businessLogicChanges as 'Label: description' strings), requirementsVsCode (criterion as verbatim AC substring, status, codeEvidence), workItemHierarchy (parent, grandparent if traversed), externalContext (Q&A answers, assumptions), openQuestions (unresolved items)
Apply severity defaults: scopeAndImpact = info, risks = warning, crossServiceConcerns = info
Escalate to critical for: cross-account access, IAM/authorization changes, failure modes, security concerns
Validate all codeChanges.files entries are objects (path, changeType, type, description)
Validate all requirementsVsCode criterion values are verbatim substrings of AC text
Write JSON file to .qa/test-plan/test-plan-context-{workItemId}.json

substeps.name: Generate HTML viewer
substeps.description: Use inject-context.cjs script with context-viewer.html template to create interactive HTML
actions: Run inject-context.cjs script with the generated JSON file path
Script uses context-viewer.html template to produce interactive HTML
Output HTML to .qa/test-plan/test-plan-context-{workItemId}.html
Verify HTML was generated successfully

substeps.name: Open HTML in browser
substeps.description: Open the generated HTML viewer in the user's default browser for review
actions: Open .qa/test-plan/test-plan-context-{workItemId}.html in the default browser
Inform user that the context viewer is open for review
Wait for user to review and explicitly approve the context
Do NOT proceed until user approves

substeps.name: End-Step: Compliance Check
substeps.description: Verify principles were followed in this step
actions: Verify: Was log.json updated for any user interactions?
Verify: JSON structure contains all required top-level keys
Verify: codeChanges.files are objects, not strings
Verify: requirementsVsCode criterion values are verbatim AC substrings
Verify: Severity defaults and escalation rules were applied correctly
Verify: User explicitly approved the context
Verify: Were mandatory actions confirmed with output?
Output: 'Step completed in compliance with operating principles'

flow.description: Compile all gathered data into structured JSON -> Generate interactive HTML viewer using inject-context.cjs -> Open HTML in browser for user review -> Wait for explicit user approval. This is an approval-required step: do NOT proceed until the user confirms the context is correct.

memoryFileUsage.readFrom: Work item details, sniffing findings, Q&A session results, qaConfig
memoryFileUsage.writeTo: testPlanContext object with file paths and approval status
fields: Decisions Made: testPlanContext.approved (boolean), severity classifications for findings
Notes: Any user feedback on context, corrections requested
